topography.project_purpose: RWA Lending. Structurally: 164 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 29 ERC20 tokens, 5 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 38 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, simplereadaccesscontroller, simplewriteaccesscontroller). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
